title: Waiting Out an Eagle
author: Wren Alder
summary: Notes from a cold week on the Skagit, when the eagles come down for the winter.
content:
Every winter, bald eagles gather along the rivers near here to feed on spent salmon. It's one of the great local shows, and you need nothing more than a pair of binoculars and warm boots.

Please keep to the marked pull-outs and stay in your car if you can. A bird that flies off because of you has burned energy it can't spare in January.
